newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BROKEN ARM SIDELINES ENGLAND'S LE TISSIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BROKEN ARM SIDELINES ENGLAND'S LE TISSIER.

text.p: Southampton's England midfielder Matthew Le Tissier will be out of action for the opening weeks of the season after breaking his arm in a friendly in Germany.

Manager David Jones was quoted on Thursday by Southampton's Clubcall line as saying that Le Tissier had suffered a bad break during the 1-1 draw with Ansbach on Wednesday. He may not play again until October.
Le Tissier signed a new four-year contract with the premier league club last month. He played for England in a World Cup qualifier against Italy in February.
